notes.title: Log Away is Coming Soon
notes.content:
[h1]Highlights[/h1]
[list]
[*] Log Away release date moved to Coming Soon
[*] We're adding new items, making gameplay tweaks, optimizing, and fixing bugs
[/list]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36323968/871689a5b6298c74fe6d0cbf918f96e4f6d0bb90.png[/img]

[h1]Coming Soon[/h1]
Goodbye August, hello Coming Soon. We moved the release date from August to an unspecified time, shrouded in mystery for now. The remaining work (described below) won't take us much more time. We're really getting close!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36323968/32a8fa4678651337f13fef62899b3f49159a054e.png[/img]

[h1]The Work[/h1]
We are adding new items! Log Away already had more than 500; that was a lot, wasn't it? Well, now it's growing even bigger, in all categories: building, furnishing, and decorating. For instance, porches! Porches will definitely increase the coziness of your log cabin.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36323968/c5d168e6ed4665b9b19660b02decc98d8e26b93b.png[/img]

As players, you need a smooth and intuitive gameplay experience. It's a fundamental principle for all video games, but it's especially important for Log Away, which aims to provide a relaxing experience. That's why we're tweaking several small details, such as the controls, the user interface, and how you build and interact with the environment.

Last but not least, we're optimizing the game to run as smoothly as possible on older configurations, plus the dreaded task of all - searching for and removing bugs.

To sum up. It's a lot of work, but most of these tasks started a few weeks back, so we're really getting close to the finish line.

Don't forget to follow and add the game to your wish list!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3468400/Log_Away/

Stay tuned for the release date announcement!

notes.title: Saint Kotar in Alpha Stage!
notes.content:
On June 18th, 2020 the Saint Kotar project was launched on Kickstarter. It was the accursed 2020, the year of Covid. A year everyone wants to forget or put in a bad place. We will certainly remember it forever as it was not only our first Kickstarter campaign, but the first ever game project we started. A year later, things are going preeeetttyy gooood!

[h2]Alpha Stage[/h2]

So, one year later, we can proudly announce that [b]Saint Kotar has entered the Alpha stage of production[/b]! Wait, what? Not a big deal? What is the Alpha stage? Each studio has its own way to define the stages of production, so a common definition that everyone abides to doesn't really exist. It is a big deal because the Alpha stage, at least in our case, means:

[list]
[*]the game is playable from start to finish. Side tasks are not yet implemented (just a few of them), but the entire critical path is.
[*]all characters and locations are obviously implemented, but still need additional work to make them look the way you, and we, want them to look.
[*]all soundtracks are implemented.
[*]the User Interface is pretty much final.
[/list]

In the Alpha stage bugs are a common thing, sound effects and character animations are mostly missing, locations don't have a final look, dialogs and puzzles are not final (they are just a first draft), etc etc. Plenty of work awaits, but if we are here, it means nothing can stop us anymore to get to the finish line!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33074762/c3e7591431825f1e3cb8935a6ea3376b8c98b426.jpg[/img]

[h2]Some Juicy Facts[/h2]

Just fired out:

[list]
[*]game has a total number of 126 locations!
[*]you can die in Saint Kotar, numerous times. Almost all deaths have a unique death cutscene.
[*]on top of the big number of locations, the game also has dozens of closeups, which is a feature the prologue was missing soooo much.
[*]first Alpha playtesters say the game is great. Yes, they say it is great and that the story is awesome. Let's calm down though, we still have a long road ahead of us, but seeing these feedback is certainly encouraging and exciting!
[/list]

[h2]Demo and Full Game Release Dates[/h2]

Our original plan was to release a new demo/prologue in June. The plan has changed and at the moment we don't have a new date. The full game release remains set for August, for now. Don't panic, if something changes, it won't change drastically because it's just not possible.

[h2]Wishlist Saint Kotar[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1358530/Saint_Kotar/

notes.title: Summary of improvements and features in Saint Kotar
notes.content:
Since after the end of the Kickstarter campaign we've been hard at work to improve and add lots of new features in Saint Kotar. Things that weren't good enough in the prologue were improved, and things that we thought were missing were implemented with the ultimate goal to make the full game an overall better experience. And, hopefully, a truly unique adventure game!

This news post summarizes all the work we've done up until now, explains the 4 pillars of Saint Kotar and, as a reward for being patient reading it, shows an in-game screenshot of a never-seen-before location in the game.

[h2]The 4 pillars[/h2]

Saint Kotar's design is based on, as we like to call them internally, the 4 pillars. They pretty much explain the vision of the game and how it'll be played, and every design and story choice is built on top of them. Essentially, they represent the core of the game!

[olist]
[*][b]Two realities:[/b] in Saint Kotar you play with two playable characters, Benedek and Nikolay. As you switch between them, in some cases (depending on the point in the story), the reality (sounds and visuals) change as well. This change of reality is connected with who the characters are and how they see the world around them, influencing as well on how you solve some puzzles.
[*][b]Death scenes:[/b] both playable characters can die during the story. I mean, it would be weird not to have death scenes in a horror game, right? If the characters live or die depends on your decisions, not on the time you need to make a decision. Like many other players, we are not fans of time based puzzles.
[*][b]Exploration:[/b] a very important element of the game. If you are adventurous enough, the game rewards you with more lore and background story, unique characters to talk to and special/unique items which you can then use to solve some puzzles in a less complex way. Exploring the town of Sveti Kotar and its surroundings is fun, dangerous and rewarding (unlocks special achievements).
[*][b]Decisions:[/b] they influence how you get through the story and how you influence the world and the characters you meet in this world. Some decisions make some puzzles easier to solve, others make them harder.
[/olist]

[h2]Technical overhaul[/h2]

The technical overhaul was the first thing we started working on after the Kickstarter. It's finished now and we are very happy with the results and what they allow us to have in the game:

[list]
[*]better, more fluid and natural-looking character animations
[*]shorter loading times and a better overall optimization of the whole system
[*]close-up scenes (something we thought was missing)
[*]cinematic cut-scenes (same, we were missing them in the prologue)
[*]support for gamepads and achievements
[*]better looking and more user-friendly UI
[/list]

[h2]Rewrite and redesign[/h2]

In the prologue the player has a role that is too passive, especially in the dialogs. So what we did was to rewrite and redesign the whole story from ground up. This doesn't mean we've changed the story, it just means that the way we are telling it was changed, and for the better. With the new design the player takes a more active role in the game, just like how it needs to be and how it had to be in the first place in the prologue. This leads me to the next point - the UI changes.

[h2]UI changes[/h2]

Dialog options now feature a portrait of the person the playable character is talking to, the last sentence that was spoken during the conversation, and the possibility to see the history (log) of that particular conversation by clicking on the expand button. Conversations are still played out outside the dialog box, just like in the prologue (with the sentences appearing above the characters' heads), and the box appears on screen only when the player has to choose what he/she wants to say or do. Take a look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38338221/613df8e9e820e440a482bcc5376f68e0021d3a54.jpg[/img]

When you are wandering around the town or doing stuff (not talking to people), instead of the inventory icon from the prologue, you now see the portrait of the character you are controlling at the moment. And, when the game allows you to switch manually between the two playable characters, a smaller portrait of the other playable character currently not being controlled is visible on screen as well. Clicking on that portrait makes the game to switch control from one character to the other:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38338221/f96eb9bd54b938e607276e19b96539f574a9df40.jpg[/img]

A new feature is the Memory system! It allows you to see all the tasks, be it completed or active, and the map of the town and its surroundings. This will be very useful as Saint Kotar not only has main tasks (or quests, if you prefer), but also side tasks that are not mandatory to be solved in order to progress through the story and finish the game. Although, if you do complete them you will be rewarded for doing so.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38338221/280892ebdfb22c1828e4b71c88f539b5b8753d58.jpg[/img]

[h2]New version of the prologue coming this summer![/h2]

The version of the prologue Saint Kotar: The Yellow Mask that was released in June 2020, and is still available, will be replaced with a [b]new version this summer[/b]! This new version, let's call it for now version 2.0, will include all the improvements and new features mentioned above in the article (obviously, the ones that the full game will have as well). It'll be a completely new experience, and it'll be made available for free, again.

[h2]New screenshot[/h2]

Thank you for sticking with the article up to this point (if you just scrolled down to see the screenshot, we won't judge you, but you are missing a lot of valuable information about the game). This is an in-game screenshot of the never-seen-before lodge location in Saint Kotar!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38338221/d7bcfff27c7f89e2396550b3bdd8cc5827f2ab58.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1358530/Saint_Kotar/

notes.title: Happy Holidays and a great 2021!
notes.content:
Click play and turn the sound on to get into the mood:

[previewyoutube=77o_aKDKnXA;full][/previewyoutube]

Yes! Even in the darkest of places, such as the world of Saint Kotar, one can find light and joy if he wants to. The year we are leaving behind was in many ways sad, hard and tragic... It was dark, but it wasn't lightless. If you are a Kickstarter backer of Saint Kotar, or have supported us in any other way, you can be very proud because you gave us the light when we were on the verge of falling into darkness. That light is driving us now into the new year, towards the completion of this project.

We wish you and yours happy Holidays and a happy, healthy, and playful 2021!

[h3]Progress[/h3]

This update is not only about good wishes, but about good development progress as well. We decided about, and have already started implementing into the game, two things:

[list]
[*]death scenes!
[*]Memory system (work in progress title)
[/list]

[b]Death scenes[/b] will be an integral part of the experience. We believe they will add so much to the overall gameplay, and the sense of dread that is crucial in psychological horror stories. I can't disclose all the juicy details about them yet, but to calm you down, they won't be designed as time puzzles. This game will be about the decisions you make, they will shape the story and the characters you meet. Death will be no different, if you live or die will depend solely on your decisions.

The [b]Memory system[/b] will allow you to see all the tasks, be it completed or active, and the map of the town and its surroundings. This will be very useful as Saint Kotar won't have a linear system of tasks (which is designed in a way that you complete one task to get a new one and so on) but there will be side tasks too (or quests, if you prefer) that are not mandatory to be solved in order to progress through the story. Although, if you do complete them you will be rewarded, in one or multiple ways.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33074762/280892ebdfb22c1828e4b71c88f539b5b8753d58.jpg[/img]

The year 2021 is going to be great! ːsteamhappyː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1358530/Saint_Kotar/

notes.title: Saint Kotar has a new official cover!
notes.content:
[h3]The new Saint Kotar cover[/h3]

Take a good, good look at it:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33074762/ee8215e3f5fe46640451e0a23937c680c172e6f2.jpg[/img]

Have you noticed? We slightly changed the logo as well. Now, you might wonder, why the new cover? Long story short, we believe the new one better represents the game and is more visually appealing than the old one. The new cover is [b]darker, more story-aligned and full of hidden symbolism[/b]. Nothing was added on the cover for the sake of making it look nicer, every single element and detail are there for a reason.

Some behind the scenes of the creation process:

[previewyoutube=xOFEWxGiSDI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]UI changes[/h3]

Aside the technical overhaul and improvements on other important stuff (such as, the smoothness and speed of animations), we've also started redesigning the user interface. Still a work in progress, but this is close to how the new dialog options box will look like in Saint Kotar:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33074762/47d4ea7f06a7353ab1a904c97226e4a0d7125883.jpg[/img]

And, still regarding the UI changes, portraits are replacing the inventory icon in the bottom-left corner:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33074762/f96eb9bd54b938e607276e19b96539f574a9df40.jpg[/img]

[h3]Narrative redesign[/h3]

We are changing things in the narrative department as well. The goal is to create a better and more enjoyable experience for the player by redesigning how the game is played and by rewriting dialogues and descriptions to make them more exciting to read. This redesign includes the content from the prologue as well and so when the times comes we will release a new version of the prologue (Saint Kotar: The Yellow Mask), for free.

[h3]Saint Kotar factsheet[/h3]

Release date: August 2021

Platforms: Steam, GOG, Nintendo Switch, Playstation, Xbox

Languages: English (text and voice), French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian

Features: Achievements, Full controller support, Cloud saving, Dev commentary

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1358530/Saint_Kotar/

notes.title: A spooky Kickstarter update!
notes.content:
It's October, the spookiest month of the year! On the other hand, nothing spooky is happening in regards to the development of Saint Kotar. Quite the opposite; work is progressing as planned and the team is happy, creative and productive!

If you want to read the longer version of this update, make yourself cozy and head over to the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/redmartyr/saint-kotar/posts/2985711]original Kickstarter post[/url]. If you prefer to know only the most essential bits, then this is the place to be!

[h3]The overhaul[/h3]

The prologue of Saint Kotar was well received, but it's far from being perfect. And we want the full game to be as perfect as possible, or at least considerably improved, so after the Kickstarter we've started doing an overhaul of the whole system which will bring to the game:

[list]
[*]concurrent actions
[*]close-up scenes
[*]cutscenes
[*]better character responsiveness and animations (smoother, faster, more natural)
[*]and, as you may have already noticed if you've played the prologue after the last update (pushed a month ago), far better loading times!
[/list]

[b]In short, we've picked up all the negative player feedback and we're working from there to improve the game on all counts.[/b]

[h3]What is happening right now[/h3]

The overhaul is still a work in progress, and it will be for some time. At the same time, we are almost at the end of a 2-month process of creating all the character models in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33074762/06af4cfcf2a415bb481d4eaec22498d3a2f3a1ef.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=Wt5T_NrhapY;full][/previewyoutube]

Lots of other things are happening in our office on a daily basis. For most of them you really don't want to know the details as they are super boring (administrative tasks), while for the rest it is not yet time to know them. We'll keep you updated on everything, don't worry, just keep following us here, on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/redmartyr/saint-kotar/]Kickstarter[/url], on any or all of our social media outlets or [url=https://discord.gg/ctwCKAw]Discord[/url].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1358530/Saint_Kotar/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1350040/Saint_Kotar_Supporter_Pack/

notes.title: All 7 hidden locations in Saint Kotar unlocked
notes.content:
[h2]Incredible effort[/h2]

The 11:00 PM CEST on Friday, July 17, deadline has passed. It was [b]a goal were we had to achieve 100% in order to unlock all the remaining hidden locations in the game[/b] (so far, only 2 of them have been unlocked with the community stretch goals). 

When we announced the goal on Thursday the project was funded 87%. At the time of writing this post we are at 94%. Even if we didn't get to 100%, an increase of 7% in two days is a great achievement. This is a result of a lot of new backers joining the project (we are now over 900 backers), but also of the many existing backers increasing their pledges. And not to forget those who have spread the word out about the campaign! Our backers were all incredible and we cannot ignore their efforts, they deserve to be rewarded:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33074762/68b77464311bef11f7136c26a13ca0f504832fa4.jpg[/img]

Yes! Even if we didn't achieve the goal, we decided to reward the amazing support they've been giving us (and not only for the past two days) by unlocking all the remaining hidden locations in the game. This means that the game will have a total number of 7 hidden locations to be uncovered! Hidden locations are locations that offer an insight into the background story and lore of the town, a non-playable character to interact with, a special item that could help with the progress at certain points in the story, or sometimes even all of the above mentioned together. To learn more about these locations, read [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/redmartyr/saint-kotar/posts/2878970]post update #4[/url].

[h2]Let's continue rising and pushing forward[/h2]

With 7 days to go until the end of the campaign we need only about 2000€ (about $2200) to fund this project! The sooner we achieve it, the quicker we'll be able to focus on the stretch goals that are waiting just around the corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33074762/dd9d217788cf10b326cbeae6745f4dcbecd3996b.jpg[/img]

Contribute to the success of the campaign, become a part of the project: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/redmartyr/saint-kotar?ref=34wgpx]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/redmartyr/saint-kotar?ref=34wgpx[/url]

notes.title: 4 new NPC tiers added, first community stretch goal achieved
notes.content:
[h2]75% funded![/h2]

Hello everyone, we have some great news today - [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/redmartyr/saint-kotar?ref=34wgpx]the Kickstarter project[/url] is going full force towards the goal, we are now [b]75% funded![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33074762/2fbc8d669a5582825e7f9c66fd95793de0b14703.jpg[/img]

Yesterday, a backer bought the 5000€ tier "One of the Seven Disciples". That tier is limited to 7 backers, so if you want to visit the mountain region of Croatia, where the fictive town of Sveti Kotar is placed, you can still pledge to it and get a wealth of nice goodies as well as in-game objects dedicated only to you. The tier was designed to let you experience the atmosphere and see with your own eyes the mysteriously beautiful region that inspired the creation of the game's world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33074762/5c30eca8067f658b6804455e9a1b850f5bb98368.jpg[/img]
[i]Gorski kotar, Croatia. The mountain region where the game takes place.[/i]

[h2]New NPC tiers added[/h2]

We have added 4 new tiers that give the backers a possibility to become a non-playable character in Saint Kotar. One of them, [b]the 1100€ tier "Head Worshipper" has already been sold out![/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33074762/160d904932437c8494fa2134642e241dd25a1e8b.jpg[/img]
The backer who pledged to the tier "Head Worshipper" became the leader of a sinister cult in Saint Kotar.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33074762/85a9c38b98558b94196394d0c39f4e8810c2a710.jpg[/img]
By pledging to the tier "Bookworm" you become the bookstore owner, a furtive woman that knows so much and yet speaks so little about the town's dark secrets. We will design this non-playable character based on your look. You can pledge to this tier or increase your existing pledge and choose this tier [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/redmartyr/saint-kotar?ref=34wgpx]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33074762/b288b600855ff65f17bf7b2032913fda8d39069e.jpg[/img]
By pledging to the tier "Chief at the Edge of Hell" you become the chief of police, a respected and feared persona in this town tormented by agony and sorrow. We will design this non-playable character based on your look and your character will be voiced (if, at least, partial voice acting stretch  goal is achieved) by Happy Anderson, the American actor best known for  his role in the Netflix's tv show Mindhunter. You can pledge to this tier or increase your existing pledge and choose this tier [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/redmartyr/saint-kotar?ref=34wgpx]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33074762/23605ad0712f375667cd480eca37a93475994b6f.jpg[/img]
By pledging to the tier "Saintly Shepherd" you become the town's priest, a highly respected person and the only true leader of this strange community. We will design this non-playable character based on your look and your character will be voiced (if, at least, partial voice acting stretch goal is achieved) by Kellen Goff, the American actor best known for his roles in The Last of Us 2 and Five Nights at Freddy's. You can pledge to this tier or increase your existing pledge and choose this tier [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/redmartyr/saint-kotar?ref=34wgpx]here[/url].

Each of these 4 new tiers include a wealth of other physical and digital goodies as well. Take a look at all the tiers of this campaign [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/redmartyr/saint-kotar?ref=34wgpx]here[/url].

[h2]First community stretch goal achieved[/h2]

We are going full force with the community stretch goals as well. One of them has been achieved, and others are progressing fine as well!

Reminder: whenever we achieve one community stretch goal, there will be a new hidden location in the game waiting to be discovered. In total, there  are se7en hidden locations to be unlocked. You can learn more about them in the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/redmartyr/saint-kotar/posts/2878970]Kickstarter post update #4[/url].

[h2]Only 7 days left![/h2]

We need only 25% to get the project funded and then only the sky is the limit! Although we have only 7 days left we can still reach even the stretch goals! Let's do it! :)

Consider supporting the project on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/redmartyr/saint-kotar?ref=34wgpx

notes.title: Classic Horror mode + Czech and Spanish (LA)
notes.content:
[h2]Classic Horror mode is here[/h2]

Have you watched our stream of the prologue on [url=https://www.facebook.com/SaintKotar/videos/289929019031602/]Facebook[/url] earlier today? It was our first ever! But not the last one, as we will stream again before the end of the campaign (most probably on Steam next time). If you hadn't have the time to watch it live, no problem, you can watch the recorded video here now: [url=https://www.facebook.com/SaintKotar/videos/289929019031602/]https://www.facebook.com/SaintKotar/videos/289929019031602/[/url]

As seen in the video, for the most part we played with the [b]new "Classic Horror" mode[/b]! It's a mode that allows to play the prologue Saint Kotar: The Yellow Mask in the vein of the old horror movies and from now on you can try it yourself, just be sure to update the game before launching it.

[h2]Czech and Spanish (LA) localization[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33074762/f67d74121f8abcd902fddc3bd207a8185ad338e1.jpg[/img]

The new update that includes the "Classic Horror" mode was pushed an hour ago. It also contains, among some minor tweaks and bug fixes, localization into 2 new languages: the [b]Czech[/b] and the [b]Spanish - Latin America[/b]. Right on time to make your weekend better! :)

[h2]A serious push on Kickstarter is needed[/h2]

At the time of writing this update, the project is [b]48% funded with 14 days to go[/b]. We need a push now, a serious push to get closer to the goal(s). We're working really hard to promote the project and the campaign, but with all the things going on right now it is very hard to be heard. It's like we're hitting a wall.

If you are a backer already, your pledge alone is a huge contribution to the project, and we're very thankful for that, but please also consider [b]getting the word out[/b]. There are players who would love to support this project, we are sure about that. They just don't know it yet, they need to find out about the game first :)

notes.title: Saint Kotar coming to consoles?
notes.content:
We are almost halfway through the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/redmartyr/saint-kotar/]Saint Kotar Kickstarter campaign[/url], in every possible sense: 46% funded with 16 days to go. So we have decided to celebrate and gift all of our 500+ amazing backers by revealing some of the previously hidden stretch goals! 

Yes, as you can see in the infographic below, the console ports are very close to the base goal! This should be a great news as many have asked us about the consoles version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33074762/a70594f00f0635b2005974c73709e08e6fe31758.jpg[/img]

More in detail:
[list]
[*][b]Project funded[/b]: the game Saint Kotar gets developed and released in 12 months after the Kickstarter campaign ends.
[*][b]Console ports[/b]: the game Saint Kotar is ported to Nintendo Switch, Playstation and Xbox platforms. Backers who pledged to Early Key to Heaven and Key to Heaven tiers and above choose for which platform they want the game key.

More stretch goals will be revealed as the visible ones get achieved. 

The full game Saint Kotar will have up to [b]20 hours of gameplay time and over 70 explorable locations[/b], created with care and improved in every segment upon the already available prologue Saint Kotar: The Yellow Mask.

notes.title: Alpha stage, release in May!
notes.content:
Saint Kotar: The Yellow Mask has entered the alpha stage! What exactly does that mean?

[h3]Polishing, and more polishing[/h3]
First and foremost, it means polishing. Right now we are conducting internal playtests that allow us to hunt and exterminate pesky bugs, as well as further refine all the aspects of the game. We’re adding new assets, fixing existing ones and putting finishing touches on location and character designs. There are some things you notice only when you playtest, so we are laser-focused on every single detail to make sure nothing is amiss.

[h3]The original plan was to release the game in April[/h3]
Our initial plan was to release in April and we were on the right track to accomplish that; however, the Coronavirus (COVID-19) changed everything, and not only for us. Our entire country and region have been hit pretty hard – everything is closed and strict measures regarding work and movement have been placed in order to slow down the spreading of the virus. Measures keep getting tighter each day in an attempt to fully stop the disease. We’ve resorted back to remote work, and for the past 10 days we’ve been working from home.

If that wasn’t enough, an earthquake hit Zagreb – the damage was quite severe, and the sound studio where our game sounds are made is now inaccessible, given that it’s located in an evacuated building; that means we must find an alternative location.

[h3]Release in May[/h3]
Unfortunately, as a consequence, our work has slowed down and some of the things that still need to be done are currently on hold. Some things are impossible to do remotely. Because of the possible further prolongation of the measures and the uncertainty we’ve decided to go with a safer goal: [b]release the prologue in May (as well as launch the Kickstarter), with the exact date to be announced by the end of April [/b]– when, hopefully, things will settle down.

Closed beta testing, exclusively for our newsletter subscribers and Discord members, will start in a few weeks. So if you want to get a chance to beta playtest the prologue, simply join our [url=https://discord.gg/ctwCKAw]Discord[/url] server or subscribe to our [url=http://eepurl.com/gMBot1]Newsletter[/url]. If you get chosen to be a part of the beta your name will be listed in the credits of Saint Kotar: The Yellow Mask!

This whole situation with the virus is horrible, but we’re all in this together, so the most important thing right now is for everyone to stay home and stay safe. Play games, read, watch the tv, spend time with your family. You know the saying - there’s always sunshine after the rain.

notes.title: New trailer, new screenshots and new description!
notes.content:
[h2]Why the silence?[/h2]
Over the past year we decided to put a halt on our PR activities due to unforeseen technical difficulties we’d faced. Until the problem was fixed we decided the best course of action would be to remain silent in order to avoid giving the community a false hope for a release. During that time we’ve received several messages from fans with raising concerns about the project’s status. We’ve felt frustrated and angry at ourselves, but at the same time we knew we were on the right track so we kept working in the shadows.

[h2]The good news[/h2]
The time has finally come to tell you the good news - we can confirm that the playable demo of Saint Kotar, titled The Yellow Mask, is well on its way and the development is coming to a conclusion. [b]We updated the whole Steam page and edited the description (all of them: ENG, GER, RUS and ITA), published a new set of screenshots (take a look in the gallery) and added a brand new trailer (seen below as well as in the gallery)[/b] to show you the progress and give you a glimpse into this mysterious world. We still don’t have a release date, as we want to be sure everything’s in its place before announcing it, but that day is fast approaching!

[previewyoutube=7ZkdWsanZh4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Up to an hour and a half of playtime[/h2]
To remind you, the release of the demo will coincide with the launch of the Kickstarter campaign. The Yellow Mask covers just the beginning of the whole story, and to be able to let you play the rest we’ll need additional funds. It’s important to note that [b]the demo will have an hour to an hour and a half of playtime[/b], with a branching story where your actions and words are fateful and affect two plotlines. We’re more than confident when we say that the long wait will be worth.

[h2]Another good news[/h2]
We have also undergone a rebranding process, changing our studio name from Tanais Games to [b][url=https://www.redmartyr.com]Red Martyr Entertainment[/url][/b]. The decision to rebrand wasn’t an easy one but we felt it was needed and the right time to do it is now. It flourished from a desire to turn the page and start fresh, leaving behind our past mistakes while nourishing the knowledge and experience we gained by doing them. We explained everything in a detailed news post on our new eye-catching website: [url=https://www.redmartyr.com/news/4/what-happened-to-us/]What happened to us?[/url]

From now on we will be posting regular updates and news here on Steam, on our website, as well as on all our [url=https://www.redmartyr.com/contact/]social media outlets[/url]. We’re back, we’re here and we’re not going away anymore. The demo is coming and going stronger than ever before!
